vetSays.line: 🛡️ Sandra, Heidi, Pablo, Sebastián and Jesse met them at the door — 5 put down. Sandra, Heidi, Pablo, Sebastián, Jesse are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sam just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sebastián just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Sebastián, Jesse, James and Nora met them at the door — 4 put down. Jesse, Nora are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
stripes flowing where no wind blows
